Could you delete this file?
rename `setdefaultDownloadsPath` to `setDefaultDownloadsPath` to follow camelCase pattern
If you want to refactor to a switch case (which makes sense to me) I think it would be better to use the "behaviour" string here instead of default

Can I return the "return" of the case statement btw without having to write return for every case? Tried to do that but does not work, i am more familiar with ruby that has explicit return

later today i will test this
Could you just remove these comments?

Could you move this to a useState? This way you can also sort the languageOptions. Something like this:

![image](https://github.com/hydralauncher/hydra/assets/167933696/075c69b9-5dda-424b-8140-5ee7392ab5d0)

Another thing that I noticed it that, the current string for portuguese language is "pt-BR", so the Select component won't have the correct language selected by default for who has portuguese language. is there already an issue about this? if not, i can create one and remove the comment

You can potentially convert this into an `options` prop, since the `Select` children will always be `<option />`
For instance:
```tsx
<Select options={[ { value: "en", label: "English" } ]} />
```

Please use lodash's `orderBy` instead
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/lodash-_-orderby-method/
